description: Retire a store note that is OUT OF DATE or WRONG, so it stops reaching every AI session on this workspace (yours and teammates'). Retiring is reversible: the note is kept with who/when/why and the merchant can restore it from the dashboard. ONLY call this when the user says a note is no longer true or wrong, or when they agree to replace several notes with one consolidated note you've just saved. NEVER retire a note on your own judgement, and never because it seems irrelevant to the current question — it may matter to a teammate's work. Confirm to the user what you retired.

noteId.description: The note's 8-character `noteId`, as shown in _storeNotes and get_store_notes.

reason.description: Why it's retired, in the user's terms (e.g. 'User says the Q2 budget freeze ended in July'). Shown on the dashboard.

store.description: Store the note belongs to (short or full domain), or 'all' to retire every copy of a note that was saved with store:'all'.

name: retire_store_note
title: Retire a store note
